flags.message: Disposition-label ambiguity affects exact-label accuracy: outcome.json records granted, while the November 13 docket entry grants only the SG's reformulated first question. codex-baseline and claude-baseline explicitly encode that matching limited-question grant as granted-in-part; gemini-baseline uses granted while forecasting the same scope. Per contract, retained the authoritative outcome and scored correct as 1/0/0, with binary Brier scores unchanged. Maintainers may wish to review cert limited-question label consistency; no input was altered.

codex-baseline's retrieval_log.json contains only eight captured BIO/cert-reply read calls, while reasoning.md and retrieval.md describe additional snapshot/statpack work, general-web requests and CourtListener research on the older Macquarie precedent. The staged log's result_capture_coverage of 1.0 measures only its present calls, not full-transcript completeness. The additional work cannot be independently audited from the captured log; no affirmative evidence of target-outcome retrieval appears, so the forward leakage assessment remains not_applicable rather than an exclusion.
